protocol_metadata.about: OnRe is a Bermuda-licensed, regulated on-chain reinsurance company operating on Solana. It offers ONyc, a yield-bearing token that combines reinsurance premiums and collateral returns, enabling institutional-grade reinsurance yield accessible to DeFi participants. The protocol manages tokenized (re)insurance pools through an Anchor-based smart contract with segregated accounts, KYC/AML enforcement, and multisig governance.
